name: bld6_abundant_two_mul_totient_lt
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (h : 2 * n ≤ ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) : 2 * n.totient < n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (h : 2 * n ≤ ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n), 2 * n.totient < n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.arith_sigma_mul_totient_lt_sq: 2n·φ(n) ≤ σ(n)·φ(n) < n^2 by the hypothesis and arith_sigma_mul_totient_lt_sq; cancel n > 0. So perfect and abundant numbers have φ(n) < n/2.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → 2 * n ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n → 2 * n.totient < n
